stories.title: Deputies say Mocksville woman shot her father as he sat on porch before running from home
stories.summary: News 2 has exclusive video of the arrest of a woman accused of shooting her father in Davie County. She was found about a mile from the scene.

stories.title: Greensboro police investigating aggravated assault on Ashe Street
stories.summary: Ashe Street is closed between South Street and Ireland Street while police investigate. Drivers are asked to avoid the area and use other routes.

stories.title: Mocksville water main repaired, but boil water advisory remains in effect
stories.summary: In an update posted at 4:15 p.m., the town asked customers to conserve water if possible for 4 to 6 hours to help restore normal water pressure.

stories.title: Weather Impact: Warm end to workweek, rain is possible by Sunday
stories.summary: Rain chances will be higher to our southeast, but scattered showers could reach as far west as the Triad by Sunday morning.

stories.title: Seven community colleges partner to prepare students for thousands of aviation jobs coming to the Triad

stories.title: Two arrested after suspect shoots at Kernersville officers before chase ends in High Point, police say
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a chase involving multiple jurisdictions ended in High Point.

stories.title: Greensboro man charged with October hotel shooting
stories.summary: A 52-year-old Greensboro man faces multiple felony charges in connection with an October shooting at a hotel.

stories.title: Trial to begin for 72-year-old Greensboro woman's murder 13 years later
stories.summary: Mildred 'Mickey' Martin was stabbed to death in 2013. Now, a man will be tried for her murder more than a decade later.

stories.title: Driver who hit and killed 8-year-old in Greensboro won't face additional charges, police say
stories.summary: Arthur Williams died after he was hit on Lowdermilk Street on October 26.

stories.title: Woman accused of shooting her father in Davie County is in custody, deputies say
stories.summary: The Davie County Sheriff's Office says 26-year-old Dharla Nicole Lawson shot her father multiple times Wednesday morning before fleeing the scene.

stories.title: Novant Health, Cone Health, Atrium Health limiting child visitors to reduce respiratory virus spread
stories.summary: Novant Health, Cone Health and Atrium Health say they will ask visitors under 13 to stay home to stop the spread of respiratory viruses this holiday season.

stories.title: Suspect identified in high-speed chase that led to Greene County deputy's death
stories.summary: A Farmville man has been arrested in connection with a high-speed chase that killed a Greene County deputy.
